about: Measured outcome shares that replace the equal-outcome convention (k of n outcomes: k/n) for generated SR/SSR chain events. Per card: the link, the choice (1-based) and each outcome's share keyed by the skill that marks it. Applied by both eras' event builders (`build_card_events.py global` and `jp`, the Grand Masters era) to `chain` and as `alt_w` (outcome weights per choice) for the solver. Measured on uma-it runs where every outcome could show (docs/MODEL.md); the value is the adopted one, and each `src` records the counts it was set from (adoption history; current evidence: docs/RESEARCH.md section 9).

30008.src: set to 0.65 on 2026-10-23 from It's All to Win: Fast-Paced 71/107 = 0.66 [0.59, 0.73] on the runs pooled then (adoption history; current evidence: docs/RESEARCH.md section 9)

30108.src: set to 0.6 on 2026-10-11 from Upping the Ante: Nothing Ventured 138/228 = 0.61 [0.55, 0.66] (90%; shared Risky Business credits attributed by each card's own rate, blank runs with Risky Business at Lv 5 split by the event's firing rate), 601 runs with the card then (adoption history; current evidence: docs/RESEARCH.md section 9)
